title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The public reader surface remains the curated numbered-paper corpus: cumulative readers, standalone English paper PDFs, compact language/source packages, and scoped source-audit correction packets.

Pending local upload queue. After the latest public version, local staging adds RA37/RA40/RA41 for Paper 04, RA42 Paper 05, RA43-RA48 Paper 06 pp.161-196, Paper 03/Paper 11/Paper 12/Paper 13 GDZ source/provenance witness support, Paper 10/Paper 11/Paper 12 compact GDZ source-audit webdrops, Paper 06 GDZ remaining-source witness pp.173-196, targeted Paper 06/Paper 07/Paper 08 audit drops, targeted German cumulative candidates P03 RA57, the compact RA58 German roll-up baseline, P21 RA59, P23 RA60, P22 RA61/RA62/RA63, P04 RA64, P02 RA65 no-patch audit, P08 RA66 no-patch micro-audit, P09/P10/P11 RA56, P14 RA55, P15 RA54, P16 RA53, P17 RA52, P18 RA51, P19 RA50, and P20 RA49, Paper 20 Lean/source-audit formula-fix material, German source-audit support companions, and a Slavic multilingual handoff through Papers 01-21 in Ukrainian, Russian, Interslavic Latin, and deterministic Interslavic Cyrillic. These pending files are not public Zenodo files until a token-backed upload/publish pass succeeds.

RA58-RA66 caveat. The RA58 package is a compact German cumulative roll-up of already targeted source-confirmed repair branches, producing a 430-page German TeX/PDF candidate. RA59 builds on RA58 and applies three Paper 21 source-confirmed repairs; RA60 builds on RA59 and applies one Paper 23 source-confirmed repair; RA61 records a Paper 22 pp.53-60 checked-no-patch audit; RA62 applies 14 Paper 22 repairs across printed pp.61-69; RA63 applies two Paper 22 repairs across printed pp.70-79; RA64 restores one Paper 04 source-visible Section 9 heading footnote on printed p.152; RA65 records the source-confirmed no-patch `L_j`/`L_j^2` finding in Paper 02; RA66 records the source-confirmed Paper 08 Omega-note bracket/factor no-patch finding. These packages reduce pending-queue fragmentation and are useful branch-reconciliation targets, but they are not fresh page-by-page certification, not critical editions, and not multilingual propagation.

Slavic handoff caveat. The Slavic package is a translation/checkpoint handoff rather than an independent source-audit closure. The visible Papers 01-21 reader TeX passed a local placeholder/mojibake grep, but some sidecar terminology/glossary JSON/log material contains question-mark mojibake; Paper 22 is WIP only and its Ukrainian/Russian working terminology seed also contains question-mark mojibake; the bundle carries provenance/tool material and raw audit/log warning history; and newer German source-audit fixes still need synchronization into those language branches.

Status at a glance. This is not a certified critical edition. The files are useful working drafts, translation drafts, source/provenance witnesses, and source-audit correction packets; subtle formula errors, scan-reading errors, apparatus drift, and cross-language synchronization errors may remain. Verify important equations, tables, theorem statements, and unusual notation against the source witnesses before citation-critical use.

Known open items. Paper 02 body pp.23-90 is closed at the RA29/RA30 page-level standard, Tabelle I p.91 is source-checked at RA31, Tabelle II p.92 rows 0-23 are checked at plate-row level through RA33/RA34, and RA65 records that the suspected body `L_j^2` display near Section 14 is source-confirmed and should not be patched by analogy with the separate Table I correction. RA41 reports Paper 04 pp.118-154 source-symbol closure at the current standard. RA48 reports Paper 06 pp.161-196 checked in a German source-critical candidate branch. Paper 03/Paper 11/Paper 12 standalone source-witness packages are provenance/witness support only; Paper 10/Paper 11/Paper 12 compact GDZ audit webdrops provide actionable patch targets and no-fix traps without applied cumulative TeX; Paper 13 has actionable audit findings plus the targeted P12/P13 RA48 candidate, but no full Paper 13 certification. The P03/P04/P09/P10/P11/P14/P15/P16/P17/P18/P19/P20/P21/P22/P23 candidates and the RA58 roll-up are targeted German repairs/consolidation only and require branch reconciliation and non-German propagation before promotion. P03 RA57 restores title spelling `Variabeln`, the source-visible Paper 03 author line, and formula (2) `\rho=\sum_i\rho_i\le n`, while recording the older Paper 05 RA42 title-footnote row as stale/closed in the current base; RA58 carries those repairs forward into the compact German roll-up; P21 RA59 applies source-confirmed Riemann cross-reference, Heun citation, and formula (143) prose-argument repairs; P22 RA62/RA63 cover targeted source-confirmed repairs across printed pp.61-79; P04 RA64 restores the source-visible Section 9 heading footnote on printed p.152; P08 RA66 records the Paper 08 Omega-note bracket/factor no-patch trap; P09/P10/P11 RA56 restores source-visible author lines and applies targeted Zermelo citation, index/display, and Omega-Gamma notation repairs; P14 RA55 applies source-confirmed repairs on printed pp.190, 198, and 200; P15 RA54 applies the printed p.152 Latin-x index repair and p.154 Schur S. 355 citation repair. Noether branch reconciliation after RA65/RA66, non-German propagation to EN/ES/JA/FR/ZH/UK/RU/ISV and the newer Slavic branches, and full symbol-level source audit beyond the checked tranches remain queued.

Corrections and collaboration. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
